plan.title: Reverse auction title restores after clearing

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction, matching the reverse-auction scenario.
Enter a title so the case can verify that clearing a typed title restores the automatic title.
Choose the reverse/buy auction template so the product sheet is available.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Clear the manually typed title without replacing the automatic title behavior.
Add the product named in the case.
Set the product row's delivery location to Plant Name, the second input used by the automatic title.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify that the empty title box regenerated the expected automatic reverse-auction title.
